The *Vipattivāra* (Pvr 1.11) is an analytical subsection of the *Parivāra*, the final collection of the Vinaya Piṭaka. The text systematically analyzes the monastic disciplinary rules by relating them to categories of "falling away" or failure (*vipatti*) from proper monastic conduct. An English translation of the section has been produced by Bhikkhu Brahmali. The secondary literature passages retrieved for this dossier match only general doctrinal and disciplinary usages of the technical term *vipatti* (such as general discussions of the four *vipattis*, boundary invalidity, or philosophical contrasts between *sampatti* and *vipatti*) rather than providing analytical commentary on this specific chapter of the *Parivāra*.

No cross-language parallels in Chinese, Sanskrit, or Tibetan traditions are recorded for this section [DharmaNexus]. Within the Pali canon, DharmaNexus records 109 internal text-reuse matches across 20 texts, reflecting the formulaic and shared pedagogical style of the Vinaya analytical treatises [DharmaNexus].
